item.tib: lha mo srid gsum bdag mo'i dbang chog dngos grub rgya mtsho
item.coloph: ces lha mo srid gsum bdag mo'i dbang bskur mchog thun dngos grub rgya mtsho 'di ni/ bstan 'dzin bon gyis (gyi) rgyal po'i pho brang bkra shis rtse yi lha khang byin rlabs dngos 'phel nang du/ kho bo kun grol grags pas bkod pa dge legs 'phel//
